mechanism: Both drugs can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities; fluconazole may inhibit metabolism of zoledronic acid through CYP450 pathways, and concurrent use increases risk of renal impairment and hypocalcemia.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) and electrolytes (calcium, phosphate, magnesium) regularly; ensure adequate hydration with zoledronic acid infusion; consider alternative antifungal if renal function declines.
